summary: A Squarespace page for the expanded Montecatini (6 weights × 4 widths) that alternates commissioned Stile Liberty poster and luggage-label artwork with plain typographic sections: an origin story with archival posters, a width × weight style list, a one-line tester with segmented style buttons, a catalogue of the ligature features, and a city-name wall with the ligatures picked out in pink.

instances.ux: static; no site nav visible in the capture
instances.learn: A single period-correct illustration (a spa fountain) placed under the name makes the hero read as a Stile Liberty travel poster, so the historical reference is felt before it is explained
